proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: build the pullback map c_y from (f_*F)_y to H^0(X_y, F) and prove it restricts to a bijection between (f_!F)_y and H^0_c(X_y, F): the image lands in compact-support sections because support commutes with pullback and properness is base-change stable; injectivity and surjectivity both reduce to X quasi-compact by quasi-compact open neighbourhoods of the supports; the quasi-compact affine case is reduced via Nagata compactification to the proper case where f_! = f_*, H^0_c = H^0, and proper base change identifies the stalks (source lines 643-760)

standard_prerequisites.name: Nagata compactification (More on Flatness, Theorem flat-theorem-nagata, canonical tag 0F41)
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the compactification used to reduce the quasi-compact affine case to the proper case.

standard_prerequisites.name: Proper base change for stalks of pushforwards (Etale Cohomology, Lemma etale-cohomology-lemma-proper-pushforward-stalk, canonical tag 0A3T)
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the stalk of Rf_* for the proper morphism bar-X -> Y in the final reduction.

core_obligations: Construct the canonical stalk map c_y from the colimit description of (f_*F)_y and show its image on the f_!-subgroup lands in the compact-support subgroup, using that support commutes with pullback and properness is preserved by base change (proof lines 643-672).
Establish the compatibility square for open subschemes X' of X with the two covariance remarks (proof lines 674-703).

Reduce injectivity to X quasi-compact by containing the support Z in a quasi-compact open X' and using the compatibility square (proof lines 705-718), reduce surjectivity to X quasi-compact by containing the support of the compact-support section in some quasi-compact open X' (proof lines 720-733), and finish the quasi-compact affine case by Nagata compactification: the vertical maps are isomorphisms by the two compactify lemmas and the proper case follows from f_! = f_*, H^0_c = H^0 and proper base change (proof lines 735-759).
proof_roadmap: Build the pullback stalk map and land the f_!-subgroup in compact-support sections (proof lines 643-672).
Prove the compatibility square for open restrictions (proof lines 674-703).
Reduce to X quasi-compact on both sides and finish via compactification and the proper case (proof lines 705-759).
